items.title: Horn Shirley — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I met one guy that, Perception, we talk all the time. He‘s a sweet man.

ctx.x: No, in Chicago, Chicago. I met one guy that, Perception, we talk all the time. He‘s a sweet man. He wrote a lot of songs, a lot of great songs. He wrote [sings] ―Have you tried to forget? When your lover has left you, it‘s so hard to forget someone you loved.‖ He did two albums there. Johnny Pate, yeah.
